ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; macro-level ratio exhibits a predominant high-intensity central region (white, approx. 85% surface area) bounded by a low-intensity peripheral frame (black, approx. 15% surface area) along the trailing edge and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous field across the majority of both lobes. Low-intensity black banding (approx. 10-30 pixels width) follows the trailing edge. Distinct dark focal spots (mottling) are clustered in the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe, with coordinate concentrations at the proximal-medial junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 62 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending roughly 12% into the total fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations characterized by irregular peaks and valleys (3-12 pixel amplitude variations) along the entire trailing boundary, with the highest amplitude serrations located at the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory on the trailing edge from the distal tips toward the median notch; the visible leading edge remains partially submerged but indicates a convex taper.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark, circular pixel clusters (3-8 pixel diameter) scattered on the ventral surface of the left lobe, primarily within the high-intensity white region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, high-contrast dark linear feature approximately 50 pixels in length oriented vertically on the far-left ventral margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical linear scar on the lower-outer margin of the left lobe; visible irregular pigmentation/mottling at the peduncle-fluke junction.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized yellow-brown chromatic variation (staining) visible on the lower medial surface of the left lobe, distinct from the primary black/white intensity distribution.
